title: English Practice Quiz 0777
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Digital Communication 01: A professional chat message should be?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: clear, respectful and relevant.

questions.question: Digital Communication 02: Before sharing a file link, check?
options: that the intended recipients have appropriate access
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: that the intended recipients have appropriate access.

questions.question: Digital Communication 03: An email subject line should?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: briefly describe the message purpose.

questions.question: Digital Communication 04: An online meeting participant should?
options: mute the microphone when not speaking
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: mute the microphone when not speaking.

questions.question: Digital Communication 05: A suspicious link in a message should be?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: verified before opening.

questions.question: Digital Communication 06: A digital signature can help?
options: confirm the signer's approval or identity under the system used
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: confirm the signer's approval or identity under the system used.

questions.question: Digital Communication 07: A group chat should not be used to?
options: share confidential information with unauthorised people
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: share confidential information with unauthorised people.

questions.question: Digital Communication 08: An out-of-office reply should include?
options: the period of absence and an alternative contact if appropriate
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: the period of absence and an alternative contact if appropriate.

questions.question: Digital Communication 09: A message sent in error should be?
options: corrected promptly with a clear clarification
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: corrected promptly with a clear clarification.

questions.question: Digital Communication 10: A professional online profile should?
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: present accurate and appropriate information.
